# Director MCP

Director renders video from HTML/CSS, Rhai and native projects. `open` an input to get a session id and its outline, then `patch` nodes by authored name against the session revision, `inspect` layout and timeline, `render_frame` to look at a frame, `qa` to score it, and `export` the video. Failed tools return `{"error":{"code","message"}}`.

## Setup

Register the server in the MCP client configuration:

```json
{"mcpServers":{"director":{"command":"director-engine","args":["mcp"]}}}
```

Add `"--gpu"` to `args` on a Vulkan build. Paths resolve against the server's working directory.

## Loop

1. `open` the input. Keep `session`, and read authored node names in `outline.roots`.
2. `render_frame` at a few times and look at the frames.
3. `patch` with `base_revision` set to the last revision. On `conflict`, read `outline` and write the ops again.
4. `inspect` at a time for layout bounds, timeline and audio.
5. `qa` and patch until `pass` holds, following each issue's `fix`; aim for a score of 100.
6. `diff` two sessions for the ops that turn one input into the other.
7. `export` with `draft: true`, check it, then export without `draft`.
8. `close` sessions when done.

## Tools

### `open`

Open an input as a session at revision 0. Returns the session id, source kind, missing fonts, compositions and outline.

- `input` (string, required): Rhai, HTML, capture JSON, native .dirproj or core project JSON path, relative to the server directory
- `composition` (string, optional): Script composition to open
- `duration` (number, optional): Seconds for inputs that do not set a duration (default 5)
- `fps` (number, optional): Frame rate for inputs that do not set one (default 30)
- `height` (integer, optional): Canvas height for inputs that do not set one (default 1080)
- `props` (any, optional): Script composition props as JSON or a JSON file path
- `width` (integer, optional): Canvas width for inputs that do not set one (default 1920)

### `close`

Close a session and free its renderers.

- `session` (string, required): Session id from `open`

### `outline`

The node tree with authored names, the clips and the current revision.

Read only.

- `session` (string, required): Session id from `open`

### `diff`

Document, added, removed, moved and changed nodes between two sessions as JSON pointers, with `patch`: the ops that turn `before` into `after` when `patchable`.

Read only.

- `after` (string, required): Session id to diff to
- `before` (string, required): Session id to diff from

### `patch`

Apply patch ops atomically and return the new revision. `set` replaces the value at a JSON pointer in a node record (`{"op":"set","node":"box","path":"/opacity","value":0.5}`), `set_document` one in the document, `remove` drops a subtree.

- `ops` (array of object, required): Ops applied in order; any failure rejects them all
  - `{"op":"set", node: string | {generation, index}, path: string, value: any}`: Replace the value at JSON pointer `path` inside the node record, such as `/opacity` or `/body/text`. Identity and tree fields (`/id`, `/parent`, `/children`) are fixed.
  - `{"op":"set_document", path: string, value: any}`: Replace the value at JSON pointer `path` of the document, such as `/fps` or `/timeline/tracks/0/clips/0/duration`. `/version` is fixed and `/nodes` changes through the node ops.
  - `{"op":"remove", node: string | {generation, index}}`: Remove the node and its subtree. A clip's scene root or a mask that a remaining node uses cannot be removed.
- `session` (string, required): Session id from `open`
- `base_revision` (integer, optional): Revision the ops were written against; a stale revision fails with `conflict`. Defaults to the current revision.

### `inspect`

Source ids, layout bounds, timeline and audio of the current revision at a time.

Read only.

- `session` (string, required): Session id from `open`
- `time` (number, optional, default `0.0`): Seconds into the timeline

### `qa`

Score the current revision 0-100 for publishing. Errors cost 20: missing fonts, nodes never on the canvas, clipped or non-finite audio. Warnings cost 5: text clipped by the canvas edge or inside the safe-zone inset for a second or more, captions over faces, reframed subjects out of frame, true peak above -1 dBTP, a silent mix, loudness more than 2 LU off target. Static stretches are info. `pass` holds with no errors. Each issue carries the authored node name, time range and a fix.

Read only.

- `session` (string, required): Session id from `open`
- `every` (number, optional, default `0.25`): Seconds between layout samples
- `loudness_target` (number, optional, default `-14.0`): Integrated loudness target of the audio mix in LUFS
- `safe_zone` (string, optional): Safe-zone preset for text: `tiktok`, `youtube_shorts`, `instagram_reel`, `instagram_story`, `linkedin`, `twitter`, `mobile` or `desktop`

### `render_frame`

Paint one frame of the current revision as PNG.

- `session` (string, required): Session id from `open`
- `output` (string, optional): Write the PNG here and return its path; without it the PNG returns as image content
- `time` (number, optional, default `0.0`): Seconds into the timeline

### `export`

Export the current revision as a video file. Fails with `missing_font` when required fonts are absent.

- `output` (string, required): Video path
- `session` (string, required): Session id from `open`
- `alpha` (boolean, optional): Leave uncovered pixels clear and write VP9 with alpha
- `draft` (boolean, optional, default `false`): Software x264 ultrafast at CRF 30
- `encoder` ("software" | "nvenc", optional, default `"software"`): Video encoder
- `scale` (number, optional): Raster scale in (0, 1]

## Errors

A failed tool returns `isError: true` with `{"error":{"code","message"}}` as text and structured content. Codes:

- `load`: The input did not load or compile.
- `conflict`: The patch named a base revision other than the current one.
- `not_found`: A node selector or session id matched nothing.
- `invalid_patch`: A patch op or the document it produced was rejected.
- `invalid_argument`: A time or option was out of range.
- `render`: A frame failed to paint.
- `export`: The export failed to paint, encode or write.
- `cancelled`: The caller cancelled the operation.
- `missing_font`: The scene needs fonts that are not installed or bundled.
